cut: Doodle 4, VIRAL CUT v1 (23 Oct) — owner: viral cuts of the Doodle films ('Test other 2 as well and rest after'); this is one of the rest. Hook first (Doodle wants a data centre in Sweden using as much power as Stockholm: the lit paper city folds into the grey box), escalate (the whole city lit → jobs: 500 says the seller, maybe hundreds says Doodle → prices nationwide, conditional), punch, loop. The v1 draft (papercut/one-stockholm) is unchanged. Captions rewritten the same day to the owner's clarity rule (the two test cuts came back for 'clarity of messaging'): every caption says plainly what, who and why on its own, with no riddles or insider shorthand.
argument: Doodle wants a data centre in Sweden using up to 2,000 MW, about all of Stockholm. Jobs: the sellers say 500, Doodle maybe hundreds. Without new power, the grid operator warns, prices rise nationwide.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Doodle wants a / data centre in / Sweden using as / much power as / [Stockholm].
text.fi: Doodle haluaa / Ruotsiin data- / keskuksen, joka / veisi sähköä kuin / [Tukholma].
text.ja: Doodleが / スウェーデンに / データセンターを / 計画。 電力は / [ストックホルム並み]。

captions.source: The station's plain statement of the story. Doodle wants: the planned purchase of the Torsboda site (Sundsvall/Timrå) for a data centre, approved by both councils on conditions, not yet closed (23 Oct). As much power as Stockholm: the outlets' comparison (Sveriges Radio: can demand as much electricity as all of Stockholm; Energinyheter, 10 Sep: more than the city of Stockholm; E.ON: up to 1,000 MW, roughly Stockholm's total demand). The hedge is on screen from frame 0 (UP TO 2,000 MW ≈ ALL OF STOCKHOLM) and in the next caption and the punchline ('up to'). Re-checked 23 Oct (plan/films/21b-one-stockholm-viral.md).

text.en: Up to 2,000 MW: / about what [all of / Stockholm] uses.
text.ja: 最大 2,000MW。 / ほぼ [ストックホルム / 全体] 分。

captions.source: Deal documents as reported (Energinyheter 10 Sep and 14 Oct; hurbra.se; Dagens PS): 650 MW in phase one, a 1,000 MW target, an option to expand to 1,800–2,000 MW; Doodle says the current talks cover up to 1 GW — hence 'up to'. Stockholm comparison: Sveriges Radio (as much as all of Stockholm) and Energinyheter (more than the city of Stockholm); a Sweco presentation puts the city's draw at roughly 1,500 MW (order of magnitude). Unchanged since v1's re-check (22 Oct) and this cut's (23 Oct).

text.en: Jobs? The towns / selling the land / say 500. Doodle: / [maybe hundreds].
text.fi: Työpaikat? Maata / myyvät kunnat / sanovat 500. / Doodle: [ehkä / satoja].
text.ja: 雇用は？ / 土地を 売る 自治体は / 500 人。 Doodleは / [数百かも]。

captions.source: 500: the sellers' figure — Torsboda Industrial Park, the municipal company of Sundsvall and Timrå selling the site, and Sundsvall municipality: at least 500 direct jobs (Sundsvall municipality release 18 Jun; SVT 'Räknar med 500 jobb i Torsboda'). 'The towns selling the land' = those municipalities and their company. Doodle: could give hundreds of jobs (Sveriges Radio, about early Aug); SVT: no clearer than somewhere between 100 and 600, still early days; 14 Oct still no job figure (Energinyheter); 23 Oct re-check: still none. Nothing on screen is in quote marks, and nothing says Doodle denied the 500.

text.en: Sweden's grid / operator: without / new power, prices / rise [nationwide].
text.fi: Kantaverkko- / yhtiö: ilman uutta / tuotantoa hinnat / nousevat [koko / maassa].
text.ja: スウェーデンの / 送電会社： 新たな / 発電が なければ / 電気代は [全国で] / 上がる。

captions.source: Svenska kraftnät, Sweden's grid operator, to Sveriges Radio ('Svenska kraftnät: Dyrare el om datacenter byggs i Torsboda'): a load like this without new generation would affect electricity prices across the whole country; it suggested the developer contribute its own generation. Echoed by Dagens PS. Conditional, as the caption says ('without new power'); a paraphrase with an attribution, not a quote. The four price areas SE1–SE4 on the map are Sweden's bidding zones.

text.en: Power: up to / all of Stockholm. / Jobs: [unclear].
text.fi: Sähköä: jopa / koko Tukholman / verran. Työpaikat: / [epäselvää].
text.ja: 電力： 最大で / ストックホルム並み。 / 雇用： [不明]。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image: the box's appliance label, an arrow reading 1 STOCKHOLM at the longest bar ('up to' in the caption), and TOO EARLY TO SAY stamped across the empty JOBS field — Doodle's own position as reported (Sundsvall municipality, 5 Aug: too early to say how many jobs; SVT: too early to answer), without quote marks. 'Unclear' is the station's summary of the two figures above. Re-checked 23 Oct: no firm Doodle job figure has been published, so the line holds.
